run_train_distdepth: run the DistDepth model training using python execute.py --exe train with configurable dataset and model options
run_eval_save_distdepth: run evaluation and save depth predictions using python execute.py --exe eval_save on a test dataset
run_eval_save_all_distdepth: run evaluation and save all depth predictions using python execute.py --exe eval_save_all for full dataset coverage
run_eval_measure_distdepth: run evaluation and measure depth accuracy metrics using python execute.py --exe eval_measure on test data
run_eval_measure_multi_distdepth: run multi-frame evaluation and measure depth accuracy using python execute.py --exe eval_measure-M with matching frames
